description: Every event for this selection by hour of day and day of week, last 7 days in UTC. Each cell is one real hour; stronger color means more. Grey means no activity; the current hour is outlined while it fills.

text.expr: extent(pluck(data('hours'), 'doc_count'))[1] > 0 ? '' : 'No activity for this selection in the last 7 days'

url.query: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR api_key.name == ?identity OR user.name == ?identity OR user.name == REPLACE(REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", ""), "^Unnamed key of ", "") OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.name IS NULL)) AND ((?identity_kind == "" OR ?identity_kind == "Any") OR (?identity_kind == "Person" AND user.email IS NOT NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Elasticsearch API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NOT NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Elasticsearch API key (name not recorded)" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_es_api_key") OR (?identity_kind == "Cloud API key" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_cloud_api_key") OR (?identity_kind == "Service account" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_service_account") OR (?identity_kind == "Failed sign-in" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) OR (?identity_kind == "Unattributed" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NULL) OR (?identity_kind == "Other" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key","_service_account")) AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT event.action IN ("authentication_failed","anonymous_access_denied")) AND user.name IS NOT NULL)) AND ((?identity == "" OR ?identity == "Any") OR user.email == ?identity OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name == ?identity) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_cloud_api_key" AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, " · Cloud API key$", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.domain == "_es_api_key" AND user.name == REPLACE(?identity, "^Unnamed key of ", "")) OR (user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND (user.domain IS NULL OR NOT user.domain IN ("_cloud_api_key","_es_api_key")) AND user.name == ?identity) OR (?identity == "(unattributed)" AND user.email IS NULL AND api_key.name IS NULL AND user.name IS NULL)) | STATS doc_count = COUNT(*) BY hour = DATE_TRUNC(1 hour, @timestamp) | EVAL ago = DATE_DIFF("hour", hour, DATE_TRUNC(1 hour, TO_DATETIME(?_tend))) | WHERE ago <= 167 | KEEP ago, doc_count

transform.calculate: datum.partial ? 'in progress — ' + format(datum.doc_count, ',') + ' so far' : format(datum.doc_count, ',')

values.expr: !(extent(pluck(data('hours'), 'doc_count'))[1] > 0) ? [] : floor(log(domain('color')[1]) / LN10 + 1e-9) - ceil(log(domain('color')[0]) / LN10 - 1e-9) >= 1 ? slice([1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000, 10000000, 100000000], ceil(log(domain('color')[0]) / LN10 - 1e-9), 1 + floor(log(domain('color')[1]) / LN10 + 1e-9)) : domain('color')[1] > 3 * domain('color')[0] ? [domain('color')[0], sqrt(domain('color')[0] * domain('color')[1]), domain('color')[1]] : domain('color')[1] > domain('color')[0] ? domain('color') : [domain('color')[0]]
